ownerViewingInstructions.step1_select_rig: In the open AnimationSandbox Studio window, locate the Motion Tools Animation Studio DockWidget panel.
ownerViewingInstructions.step2_rig_library: On the left icon rail of Motion Tools, click the "R" tab (Rig Library).
ownerViewingInstructions.step3_choose_r6: Click "R6_Rig" (the top row). The status will display "Rig ready: R6_Rig".
ownerViewingInstructions.step4_animation_library: Click the "A" tab (Animation Library) on the icon rail.
ownerViewingInstructions.step5_refresh_and_browse: Click "Refresh library (52)". All 52 persistent clips are loaded and individually selectable.
ownerViewingInstructions.step6_inspect_active_first: Click any clip (recommended first active clip: P03_HeavyKnockOn_v01 or P02_Dash_Burst_v02) to load it onto R6_Rig, play, stop, or scrub the timeline.
ownerViewingInstructions.step7_evaluate: Inspect active clips, compare against v01 references, inspect retired moves if desired, and provide visual review feedback.

boundedBlockerAndOwnerStep.requiredOwnerAction: In Cage-Zero Studio (PlaceId 137721422246269, Edit mode), click 'Animation Studio' button in 'Motion Tools' toolbar to open DockWidget, then select R6_Rig from Rig Library
exactSteps: 1. Focus on Roblox Studio window: Cage-Zero (PlaceId 137721422246269, Edit mode).
2. Look at the top Studio ribbon toolbar for 'Motion Tools'.
3. Click the 'Animation Studio' button to toggle the DockWidget ('RobloxMotionTools') open.
4. On the DockWidget left icon rail, click the 'R' icon (Rig Library tab).
5. Select 'R6_Rig' (already present in ServerStorage.MotionToolsRigs). Status updates to 'Rig ready: R6_Rig'.
6. On the left icon rail, click the 'A' icon (Animation Library tab) to view and refresh persistent clips.
